headings: Advancing LGBTQ Health and Human Rights Globally—Grindr for Equality and Government Affairs
paragraphs: Our mission is to build the Global Gayborhood in Your Pocket™, and, through our success, to make a world where the lives of our global LGBTQ community are free, equal, and just. We manage and operate the Grindr platform, a global social networking platform primarily serving and addressing the needs of gay, bisexual, and sexually explorative adults around the world. We had 15.0 million, 14.2 million, and 13.3 million Average MAUs for the years ended December 31, 2025, 2024, and 2023, respectively. Additionally, we had 1.3 million, 1.1 million, and 0.9 million Average Paying Users for the years ended December 31, 2025, 2024, and 2023, respectively. We enable our users to find and engage with one another, share content and interests, discover products and experiences relevant for them, and generally express their unique selves. As a "gayborhood" on our users' mobile devices, our platform is a meaningful part of our users' lives and has embedded us at the center of their communities, as they seek relationships of various forms, whether intimate, romantic, or social.

As a company built by gay people for gay people, Grindr fulfills crucial needs for its users. While the broader global landscape of social networks is highly competitive with many different platforms, there are few global platforms that focus solely on the gay, bisexual, transgender, and queer ("GBTQ") community and address their unique needs. Our platform enables GBTQ adults to connect with one another and the world. Our users have a range of intentions and use cases. Our platform helps our users find what they are looking for: casual dating, long-term relationships, community and friendships, professional networking, travel information, and local discovery. By facilitating the connection of our users around the world, we believe we can help our community find one another; advance lesbian, gay, bisexual, transgender, and queer ("LGBTQ") rights globally; and make the world a safer place for our community.

The Grindr platform has become an integral part of the daily lives of our millions of users, enabling them to discover and connect with one another effortlessly anytime. The Grindr platform offers a variety of location-based social features and functions, including identity expression (profile, photos, presence, Taken on Grindr); connection (search, filters, the Cascade, Viewed Me, Right Now, recommendations); and interaction (chat, media sharing, Discover, interactive map); with trust and safety tools across the experience, and subscriptions for premium features offering further access and control. Since our inception, we have continued to innovate and enhance the Grindr platform, adding new features and safety elements, which has allowed us to increase engagement of our monthly active users ("MAUs"). The Grindr platform has benefited from first mover advantage globally, resulting in MAUs in over 190 countries and territories.
We have attracted a highly engaged and growing user base, as evidenced by the following:
•15.0 million Average MAUs in 2025. Increased by 5.2% in 2025 as compared to 2024.
•1.3 million Average Paying Users in 2025. Increased by 16.9% in 2025 as compared to 2024.
•MAUs in over 190 countries and territories in the world as of December 31, 2025.
•21 supported languages on our platform as of December 31, 2025.

Our target market is the worldwide LGBTQ community. We believe we have significant opportunities to leverage our unique brand to both broaden and deepen our market penetration and offer products and services that address the growing and specific needs of our community. The Grindr platform offers a combination of social networking functions and digital content, and we have continued to expand our platform and impact in the following ways:
•We help people find meaningful connections, whether it's casual dating, relationships and love, community and friendships, travel information, or local discovery.
•Our platform builds community and friendships. Our user experience is essentially a world without walls, connecting one user to the next, allowing the community to see one another.
•We strive to make a world where the lives of our global community are free, safe, equal and just.

•Grindr for Equality is a core initiative at Grindr dedicated to accelerating a world where LGBTQ people in every country are equal before the law, are free to marry, and have their unique health needs met. In partnership with public health authorities and LGBTQ non-governmental organizations, Grindr for Equality harnesses the power of the Grindr platform and provides funding to advance key health and human rights priorities for our community.
•We further support the LGBTQ community through donations to local, national, and international LGBTQ organizations.

headings: Risks Related to Our Brand, Products and Services, and Operations
Changes to our existing products and services could fail to attract or retain users or generate revenue and profits.
We may not be able to successfully implement our new product and services roadmap, which could adversely impact our business, financial conditions or results of operations.
Unfavorable media coverage could materially and adversely affect our business, brand, or reputation.
Our user growth, engagement, and monetization on mobile devices depend upon effective operation with mobile operating systems, networks, and standards that we do not control.
Our success depends on the demographics of the community that we serve and our ability to foresee and respond to changing market and user demands.
Our growth and monetization strategies may not be successfully implemented or generate sustainable revenue and profit.
Our product development, investment, and other business decisions may not prioritize short-term financial results and may not produce the long-term benefits that we expect.

The failure to attract new advertisers, the loss of existing advertisers, a deterioration in any of our advertising relationships, or a reduction in their spending could adversely impact our business.
paragraphs: Investing in our securities involves a high degree of risk. Before you make a decision to buy our securities, in addition to the risks and uncertainties discussed above under "Special Note Regarding Forward-Looking Statements," you should carefully consider the risks and uncertainties described below together with all of the other information contained in this Annual Report, including our financial statements and related notes appearing at the end of this Annual Report and in the section titled "Management's Discussion and Analysis of Financial Condition and Results of Operations." If any of the events or developments described below were to occur, our business, prospects, operating results, and financial condition could suffer materially, the trading price of our securities could decline, and you could lose all or part of your investment. The risks and uncertainties described below are not the only ones we face. Additional risks and uncertainties not presently known to us or that we currently believe to be immaterial may also adversely affect our business.

Our business can be impacted by market perception of the Grindr brands; if events occur that damage our reputation and brand, our ability to maintain and expand our base of users may be impaired, and our business could be materially and adversely affected.

We believe that the Grindr brands have significantly contributed to the success of our business. Our business and financial performance are impacted by the strength and market perception of our brands. We have achieved significant organic growth mainly through word-of-mouth referrals to our platform, and therefore we believe it is critical to ensure that our users remain favorably inclined toward the Grindr brands. We have not historically relied on traditional advertising for user acquisition, and there are no guarantees that we will be successful if we choose to do so. We believe that maintaining and evolving our brands is critical to expanding our user base and growing our advertising relationships.

The strength of our brands depends on an array of factors, including our ability to continue to provide useful, fun, reliable, trustworthy, and innovative products and services, which may or may not resonate with our users as successfully as we expect. Our new products and services may not always appeal to our users, which may negatively affect our brand and our ability to attract new users, or upgrade free users to paid accounts. See "—If we fail to retain existing users or add new users, or if our users decrease their level of engagement with our products and services or do not convert to Paying Users, our revenue, financial results and business may be significantly harmed." In addition, the actions of our advertisers or partners may negatively affect our brands if users have a negative impression of such brands or do not have a positive experience using third-party products or services that are advertised on or integrated into our platform. See "—We rely primarily on the Apple App Store and Google Play Store for distribution of and access to our products and services, and as the channels for processing substantially all direct consumer payments. In addition, access to our products and services depends on mobile app stores and other third parties such as data center service providers, as well as third-party computer systems, internet transit providers and other communications systems and service providers. If these third parties limit, prohibit, fail to operate, or otherwise interfere with the distribution or use of our products or services in any material way, or if our relationships with Apple, Google, or other such third parties deteriorate, it could materially and adversely affect our business, financial condition, and results of operations." Moreover, illegal or inappropriate conduct by users, advertisers, partners, or bad actors may adversely affect our brands, particularly if we fail to respond expeditiously to objectionable content or misconduct on our platform or otherwise to address user concerns. See "—Illegal or inappropriate actions by our users or user-generated content could be attributed to us and damage our brand or reputation; subject us to regulatory inquiries, legal action, or other liabilities; or could result in us making changes to our products to mitigate litigation or regulatory risks, which, in turn, could materially adversely affect our business." We have also experienced, and expect to continue to experience, significant media, legislative, and regulatory scrutiny, as well as litigation, other legal actions, and regulatory investigations, in the U.S. and abroad, regarding user privacy and data protection, interactions between users, and other issues. For example, over the last few years, we have received and responded to inquiries from the Spanish Data Protection Authority, the Slovenian Data Protection Authority, the Greek Data Protection Authority, the Austrian Data Protection Authority, and other non-EU data protection authorities, including the Norwegian Data Protection Authority and the UK Information Commissioner's Office ("ICO"), and various U.S. regulators. See "—We and the third parties with whom we work are subject to varying and rapidly evolving regulatory frameworks on data privacy and data protection, and our (or the third parties with whom we work) actual or perceived failure to comply with such new or evolving regulations has in the past harmed our business and could continue to result in claims, changes to our business

practices, damages or monetary penalties, increased cost of operations, or declines in user growth or engagement, any of which could materially harm our business." These and other inquiries may have harmed our reputation and brands and may seriously harm our reputation and brand in the future. See "—Unfavorable media coverage could materially and adversely affect our business, brand, or reputation." If events occur that damage our reputation or brands, our business, financial condition, and results of operations could be materially and adversely affected.

Our ability to retain, expand, engage, and monetize our user base, and to increase our revenue, is rooted in our ability to keep pace with user expectations and technological changes in the industry by, among other things, continuing to evolve our existing products and services. We operate in an industry characterized by rapidly changing technologies, frequent new product and service announcements and enhancements, and changing user demands, and our competitors, including those in the online social networking and dating app industries are constantly developing new technologies and products and services. Our performance will therefore be determined by our ability to adapt in response to this environment by, among other things, continuing to improve the speed, performance, features, ease of use, and reliability of our products and services. Any failure to keep pace with rapid technological changes could cause us to lose or fail to increase market share and thus have a material adverse effect on our business, financial condition, and results of operations.

Grindr Inc.'s ("Grindr", "we", "us", "our" or the "Company") mission is to build the Global Gayborhood in Your Pocket™, and, through our success, to make a world where the lives of our global LGBTQ community are free, equal, and just. We manage and operate the Grindr platform, a global social networking platform primarily serving and addressing the needs of gay, bisexual, and sexually explorative adults around the world. We had 15.0 million, 14.2 million, and 13.3 million Average MAUs for the years ended December 31, 2025, 2024, and 2023, respectively. Additionally, we had 1.3 million, 1.1 million, and 0.9 million Average Paying Users for the years ended December 31, 2025, 2024, and 2023, respectively. Through gayborhood expansion initiatives, we are developing new products and services for users to engage with through the Grindr platform, which include new partnership-based digital versions of services typically found in physical gayborhoods. Our social impact division, Grindr for Equality, advances human rights, health, and safety for millions of lesbian, gay, bisexual, transgender, and queer ("LGBTQ") people in partnership with organizations in every region of the world.

The Grindr mobile application is free to download and provides certain services and features to Grindr's users at no cost. We also offer a variety of additional controls and features for users who enroll in our paid subscriptions and add-on products. A substantial portion of our revenue is from direct revenue, representing 83.3%, 84.4%, and 86.8% of total revenue for the years ended December 31, 2025, 2024, and 2023, respectively. Direct revenue is derived from users in the form of subscription fees, providing our users access to a variety of features for the period of their subscription. Our current subscription offerings are Grindr XTRA and Grindr Unlimited. We utilize a freemium model to drive increased user acquisition, subscriber conversions, and monetization on the Grindr platform. We also offer premium add-ons on a pay-per-use, or a-la-carte, basis. Leveraging strong brand awareness and our significant user network stemming from our first mover advantage in the gay, bisexual, transgender, and queer ("GBTQ") social networking industry, our historical growth in number of users has been driven primarily by word-of-mouth referrals and other organic means.

In addition to our revenue generated from subscription fees and premium add-ons, we also generate indirect revenue, representing 16.7%, 15.6%, and 13.2% of total revenue for the years ended December 31, 2025, 2024, and 2023, respectively. Indirect revenue includes both first-party and third-party advertising. We provide advertisers with the opportunity to directly reach the GBTQ community, a group with significant global purchasing power and economic potential. We have attracted advertisers from a diverse array of industries, including healthcare, entertainment, gaming, travel, and consumer goods. We offer our partners a diverse range of advertising opportunities to advertisers, including in-app banners, full-screen interstitials, and other customized units, typically sold on a cost per mille ("CPM") basis. Additionally, we contract with a variety of third-party advertising platforms to market and sell digital advertising inventory available on the Grindr platform. We will continue to evaluate opportunities to increase advertising inventory by both enhancing and differentiating our advertising offerings in addition to scaling our advertising volume.

We generated $439.9 million, $344.6 million, and $259.7 million of revenue, for the years ended December 31, 2025, 2024, and 2023, respectively, representing a year-over-year increase of 27.6% in 2025 compared to 2024, and year-over-year increase of 32.7% in 2024 compared to 2023.

We had 1.3 million, 1.1 million, and 0.9 million Average Paying Users, for the years ended December 31, 2025, 2024, and 2023, respectively, representing a year-over-year increase of 16.9% in 2025 compared to 2024, and year-over-year increase of 14.8% in 2024 compared to 2023.

While we have users in over 190 countries and territories, we intend to grow our user base and revenues by continuing to introduce new and innovative products and services to all of our users across the globe.

On January 23, 2025, we provided notice that we would redeem all of our outstanding warrants, which consisted of (i) 18,560,000 private placement warrants; (ii) 13,799,825 public warrants; (iii) 2,500,000 forward purchase warrants; and (iv) 2,500,000 backstop warrants, on February 24, 2025. After we announced the redemption of the warrants and before the conclusion of the redemption notice period on February 24, 2025, an aggregate of 27,315,105 warrants were exercised for an aggregate of 27,315,105 shares of our common stock at an exercise price of $11.50 per share, for aggregate cash proceeds to us of $314.1 million. In addition, 9,469,634 warrants were exercised on a cashless basis in exchange for the issuance of 3,418,518 shares of our common stock. At the conclusion of the redemption notice period on February 24, 2025, we redeemed the remaining 575,086 warrants issued and outstanding at a price of $0.10 per warrant for aggregate cash payment of $0.1 million. The public warrants were delisted from the New York Stock Exchange on February 24, 2025.

In July 2023, the Communications Workers of America AFL-CIO ("CWA") filed an election petition with the National Labor Relations Board ("NLRB") seeking to hold a representation election for certain classifications of our employees. CWA subsequently filed several unfair labor practice charges against us with the NLRB, including a request for injunctive relief under Sec. 10(j) of the National Labor Relations Act. Regarding the election petition, the NLRB conducted a secret mail-ballot election and held partial vote counts in November and December 2023. As of the date of filing of this Annual Report, the NLRB has not completed tallying all the votes from the election as there are numerous outstanding challenged ballots. In addition, on November 1, 2024, the local regional office of NLRB issued a complaint on the unfair labor practice charges. A hearing commenced in May 2025 and is expected to continue through at least April 2026. This complaint is the first step in the administrative process and is not a finding of any wrongdoing, nor is it a decision or ruling of the NLRB.
For the years ended December 31, 2025, 2024, and 2023, we generated:

•Revenue of $439.9 million, $344.6 million, and $259.7 million, respectively, representing a year-over-year increase of $95.3 million, or 27.6%, in 2025 compared to 2024, and year-over-year increase of $84.9 million, or 32.7%, in 2024 compared to 2023.
•Net income of $94.8 million, net loss of $131.0 million, and net loss of $55.8, respectively. This resulted in a net income (loss) margin of 21.5%, (38.0)%, and (21.5)%, respectively.

•Adjusted EBITDA of $195.6 million, $147.3 million, and $110.2 million, respectively, representing a year-over-year increase of $48.3 million, or 32.8%, in 2025 compared to 2024, and year-over-year increase of $37.1 million, or 33.7%, in 2024 compared to 2023. See "Management's Discussion and Analysis of Financial Condition and Result of Operations—Non-GAAP Financial Measures—Adjusted EBITDA" for more details on the calculations and reconciliations.

paragraphs: 本公司之使命為建立一個在口袋中的全球同志聚落™，並透過我們的成功，使全球同志社羣的生活得以自由、平等與正義。本公司管理並運作Grindr平台，為全球的同志、雙性戀及性探索成人提供一個全球性的社交網路平台，以服務並解決其需求。本公司於2025年12月31日財務年度終了時，平均每月活躍用戶數為15.0百萬、14.2百萬及13.3百萬。此外，本公司於2025年12月31日財務年度終了時，平均付費用戶數為1.3百萬、1.1百萬及0.9百萬。本公司協助用戶尋找並與他人互動，分享內容與興趣，發現與其相關的產品與體驗，並一般性地表達其獨特自我。作為一個位於用戶行動裝置上的「同志聚落」，本公司平台是用戶生活的重要一部分，已將我們嵌入其社羣中心，使其在尋求各種形式的關係時，如親密、浪漫或社交關係，都能找到我們。

作為由同志所建立、為同志所服務的公司，Grindr為其用戶滿足了重要的需求。雖然全球社交網路的整體環境競爭激烈，擁有許多不同的平台，但專注於同志、雙性戀、跨性別及酷兒（"GBTQ"）社羣並解決其獨特需求的全球性平台卻極為稀少。本公司平台讓GBTQ成人能夠與彼此及世界連結。用戶的意圖與使用情境多樣化。本公司平台協助用戶找到他們所尋求的東西：偶遇式約會、長期關係、社羣與友誼、專業人脈、旅遊資訊與本地探索。透過促進全球用戶的連結，我們相信我們能協助社羣找到彼此；推進全球的同志、雙性戀、跨性別及酷兒（"LGBTQ"）權益；並使我們的社羣在這個世界上更安全。

Grindr平台已成為數百萬用戶日常生活中不可或缺的一部分，使他們能隨時輕鬆地發現並與他人連結。Grindr平台提供多種基於地理位置的社交功能與功能，包括身分表達（個人資料、照片、在線狀態、Grindr上拍攝）；連結（搜尋、過濾器、瀑布流、查看我、此刻、推薦）；以及互動（聊天、媒體分享、發現、互動地圖）；並在整個體驗中提供信任與安全工具，以及訂閱服務以取得更多功能與控制權。自本公司成立以來，我們持續創新並提升Grindr平台，增加新功能與安全元素，使我們能提高每月活躍用戶數（"MAUs"）的參與度。Grindr平台在全球率先推出，使其在超過190個國家與地區擁有MAUs。
本公司已吸引高度參與且持續成長的用戶羣，如下所述：
•2025年平均每月活躍用戶數為15.0百萬。與2024年相比，2025年成長5.2%。
•2025年平均付費用戶數為1.3百萬。與2024年相比，2025年成長16.9%。
•截至2025年12月31日，Grindr平台在全球超過190個國家與地區擁有每月活躍用戶數。
•截至2025年12月31日，Grindr平台支援21種語言。
本公司之目標市場為全球LGBTQ社羣。本公司認為有相當機會利用本公司獨特品牌，以拓展並深化市場佔有率，並提供符合該社羣日益增長且特定需求之產品與服務。Grindr平台提供社交網路功能與數位內容之組合，本公司持續透過以下方式擴展平台與影響力：
•本公司協助人們建立有意義的連結，無論是隨機約會、人際關係與愛情、社羣與友誼、旅遊資訊或當地探索。
•本公司平台建立社羣與友誼。用戶體驗基本上是一無邊界的 world，將一位用戶與下一位用戶連結，使社羣得以看見彼此。
•本公司致力於創造一個讓本公司全球社羣生活自由、安全、平等且公正的世界。
•Grindr for Equality為本公司核心倡議，專注於加速實現一個在各國LGBTQ人士皆能法律平等、自由結婚並獲得其獨特健康需求之世界。透過與公共衛生機構及LGBTQ非政府組織合作，Grindr for Equality運用Grindr平台之力量，並提供資金以推進該社羣關鍵的健康與人權優先事項。
•本公司進一步透過對本地、國家及國際LGBTQ組織之捐款，支持LGBTQ社羣。

paragraphs: 以下有關我們財務狀況與營運成果之討論與分析，應配合本年度報告中其他處所載之合併財務報表及相關附註一併閱讀。除經審計之合併財務資訊外，以下討論包含前瞻性陳述，反映我們之計畫、預估、信念與預期，這些陳述涉及風險與不確定性。我們實際之結果與事件之時程可能與這些前瞻性陳述所討論者有重大差異。導致這些差異之因素包括下文及本年度報告其他處所討論之內容，特別是在第一部分，第 1A 項「風險因素」及「關於前瞻性陳述之特別說明」。

Grindr Inc.（"Grindr"、"我們"、"我們"、"我們" 或 "本公司"）之使命為建立「Global Gayborhood in Your Pocket™」，並透過我們之成功，使全球 LGBTQ 社羣之生活得以自由、平等與正義。我們管理並運作 Grindr 平台，為全球服務並解決同性戀、雙性戀及性探索成人之需求之全球社交網路平台。我們於 2025 年 12 月 31 日財年終結時，平均每月活躍用戶數為 15.0 百萬、14.2 百萬及 13.3 百萬。此外，我們於 2025 年 12 月 31 日財年終結時，平均付費用戶數為 1.3 百萬、1.1 百萬及 0.9 百萬。透過 gayborhood 擴張計畫，我們正在開發新產品與服務，供用戶透過 Grindr 平台使用，包括基於合作夥伴之數位版本服務，通常為實體 gayborhood 所提供。我們之社會影響部門 Grindr for Equality，與全球各地區之組織合作，推動人權、健康與安全，為數百萬名女同性戀、男同性戀、雙性戀、跨性別與酷兒（"LGBTQ"）人士提供協助。

Grindr 手機應用程式可免費下載，並為 Grindr 用戶提供某些服務與功能，不收取費用。我們也為註冊我們付費訂閱與附加產品之用戶提供多種額外控制與功能。我們營業收入之大部分來自直接收入，分別為 2025 年 12 月 31 日財年終結時總營業收入之 83.3%、2024 年 12 月 31 日財年終結時總營業收入之 84.4% 及 2023 年 12 月 31 日財年終結時總營業收入之 86.8%。直接收入來自用戶，形式為訂閱費用，提供用戶於訂閱期間使用多種功能。我們目前之訂閱服務為 Grindr XTRA 及 Grindr Unlimited。我們採用 freemium 模式，以提高用戶採用率、訂閱轉化率與平台之營收。我們也提供高階附加產品，按使用付費或點選付費方式。透過強大品牌知名度與我們在同性戀、雙性戀、跨性別與酷兒（"GBTQ"）社交網路產業之先發優勢所建立之大量用戶網路，我們過去之用戶數增長主要來自口碑推薦及其他自然方式。

除我們透過訂閱費用與高階附加產品所產生之營收外，我們也產生間接營收，分別為 2025 年 12 月 31 日財年終結時總營收之 16.7%、2024 年 12 月 31 日財年終結時總營收之 15.6% 及 2023 年 12 月 31 日財年終結時總營收之 13.2%。間接營收包括第一方與第三方廣告。我們為廣告商提供機會，直接接觸 GBTQ 社羣，該羣體具備顯著全球購買力與經濟潛力。我們已吸引來自多個產業之廣告商，包括醫療、娛樂、遊戲、旅遊與消費性產品。我們為合作夥伴提供多樣化之廣告機會，包括應用程式內橫幅廣告、全螢幕插頁廣告及其他客製化單元，通常以每千次展示費用（"CPM"）方式銷售。此外，我們與多種第三方廣告平台合作，以行銷與銷售 Grindr 平台之數位廣告存貨。我們將持續評估機會，透過提升與差異化我們之廣告服務，以及擴大廣告量，以增加廣告存貨。
我們於 2025 年 12 月 31 日財年終結時，產生 439.9 百萬美元、344.6 百萬美元及 259.7 百萬美元之營收，分別代表 2025 年較 2024 年成長 27.6%，以及 2024 年較 2023 年成長 32.7%。
我們於 2025 年 12 月 31 日財年終結時，平均付費用戶數為 1.3 百萬、1.1 百萬及 0.9 百萬，分別代表 2025 年較 2024 年成長 16.9%，以及 2024 年較 2023 年成長 14.8%。
雖然我們在超過 190 個國家與地區擁有用戶，我們意圖透過持續向全球所有用戶推出新穎與創新之產品與服務，來擴大用戶羣與營收。

2025 年 1 月 23 日，我們通知將贖回所有未償還之認購權證，包括（i）18,560,000 股私人 placements 權證；（ii）13,799,825 股公開權證；（iii）2,500,000 股 forward purchase 權證；及（iv）2,500,000 股 backstop 權證，於 2025 年 2 月 24 日贖回。在我們宣佈贖回權證後，且在 2025 年 2 月 24 日贖回通知期結束前，總計 27,315,105 個權證被執行，換取總計 27,315,105 股我們之普通股，每股執行價格為 11.50 美元，總計現金收入為 314.1 百萬美元。此外，總計 9,469,634 個權證以無現金方式執行，換取發行 3,418,518 股我們之普通股。在 2025 年 2 月 24 日贖回通知期結束後，我們贖回剩餘 575,086 個發行且未償還之權證，每股價格為 0.10 美元，總計現金支付為 0.1 百萬美元。公開權證於 2025 年 2 月 24 日從紐約證券交易所除牌。

2023 年 7 月，美國通訊工會（AFL-CIO）（"CWA"）向國家勞資關係委員會（"NLRB"）提出選舉請願，要求為我們某些員工類別舉行代表選舉。CWA 隨後向 NLRB 提出數項不當勞動行為指控，包括根據國家勞資關係法第 10(j) 節請求發出禁制令。關於選舉請願，NLRB 進行了祕密郵遞選舉，並於 2023 年 11 月及 12 月進行部分計票。截至本年度報告提交日，NLRB 尚未完成計數選舉的所有選票，因為有許多待處理的爭議選票。此外，2024 年 11 月 1 日，NLRB 地區辦公室針對不當勞動行為指控提出訴狀。聆訊於 2025 年 5 月開始，預計將持續至至少 2026 年 4 月。此訴狀是行政程序的第一步，並非任何過錯的裁定，也非 NLRB 的決定或裁決。
截至 2025 年 12 月 31 日、2024 年 12 月 31 日及 2023 年 12 月 31 日的會計年度，我們產生：
•營業收入為 439.9 百萬美元、344.6 百萬美元及 259.7 百萬美元，分別代表 2025 年相比 2024 年營業收入年增 95.3 百萬美元，或 27.6%，以及 2024 年相比 2023 年營業收入年增 84.9 百萬美元，或 32.7%。
•淨收入為 94.8 百萬美元、淨虧損為 131.0 百萬美元及淨虧損為 55.8 百萬美元，分別產生 21.5%、(38.0)% 及 (21.5)% 的淨收入（虧損）邊際率。

•調整後營運資金為 195.6 百萬美元、147.3 百萬美元及 110.2 百萬美元，分別代表 2025 年相比 2024 年調整後營運資金年增 48.3 百萬美元，或 32.8%，以及 2024 年相比 2023 年調整後營運資金年增 37.1 百萬美元，或 33.7%。有關調整後營運資金的計算及調整方法，請參閱 "管理層對財務狀況及營運成果之討論與分析—非 GAAP 財務指標—調整後營運資金"。

paragraphs: 投資本公司證券涉及高度風險。在您決定購買本公司證券之前，除了上述 "特別提醒有關前瞻性陳述" 部分所討論的風險與不確定性外，您應謹慎考慮下列所描述的風險與不確定性，並配合本年度報告中所有其他資訊，包括本年度報告末尾的財務報表及其相關附註，以及 "管理層對財務狀況與營運成果之討論與分析" 節。若下列所描述的任何事件或發展發生，將可能對本公司業務、前景、營運結果與財務狀況造成重大影響，本公司證券交易價格可能下跌，您可能損失全部或部分投資。下列所描述的風險與不確定性並非本公司所面臨的唯一風險。尚有其他風險與不確定性，目前本公司尚未知悉或目前認為不重要，也可能對本公司業務造成不利影響。
本公司業務可能受市場對 Grindr 品牌的觀感影響；若發生損害本公司聲譽與品牌的事件，將可能影響本公司維持與擴大用戶羣體的能力，並對本公司業務造成重大且不利的影響。
本公司認為 Grindr 品牌已對本公司業務的成功產生顯著貢獻。本公司業務與財務表現受品牌強度與市場觀感的影響。本公司主要透過口碑推薦來實現顯著的內生性成長，因此本公司認為確保用戶對 Grindr 品牌保持正面觀感至關重要。本公司歷來未依賴傳統廣告來獲取用戶，若本公司選擇進行此類活動，並無保證能成功。本公司認為維持與進化品牌至關重要，以擴大用戶羣體並成長廣告合作關係。

本公司品牌之強度取決於多項因素，包括本公司持續提供有用、有趣、可靠、可信任且創新之產品與服務之能力，這些產品與服務可能無法如本公司預期般成功引起用戶之共鳴。本公司之新產品與服務可能不總是受到用戶歡迎，這可能會對本公司品牌及吸引新用戶或將免費用戶升級為付費帳號之能力產生負面影響。請參閱 "—若本公司無法保留現有用戶或增加新用戶，或若用戶對本公司產品與服務之參與度降低或未轉為付費用戶，本公司之營業收入、財務結果及業務可能受到重大損害。" 此外，廣告商或合作夥伴之行為可能對本公司品牌產生負面影響，若用戶對這些品牌有負面印象，或未在本公司平台廣告或整合之第三方產品與服務上獲得正面體驗。請參閱 "—本公司主要依賴 Apple App Store 及 Google Play Store 來分發及取得本公司產品與服務，並作為處理幾乎所有直接消費者付款之渠道。此外，取得本公司產品與服務之能力取決於行動應用程式商店及其他第三方，例如資料中心服務供應商，以及第三方電腦系統、網際網路轉接供應商及其他通訊系統與服務供應商。若這些第三方限制、禁止、無法運作或以其他方式幹擾本公司產品與服務之分發或使用，或若本公司與 Apple、Google 或其他第三方之關係惡化，可能會對本公司業務、財務狀況及營運結果造成重大且不利之影響。" 此外，用戶、廣告商、合作夥伴或不良行為者之非法或不當行為可能對本公司品牌造成不利影響，特別是在本公司未能迅速回應平台上之不當內容或不當行為，或未能處理用戶之關注時。請參閱 "—本公司用戶之非法或不當行為或用戶生成內容可能被歸咎於本公司，損害本公司品牌或聲譽；使本公司面臨監管機構調查、法律行動或其他責任；或可能導致本公司對產品進行修改以降低訴訟或監管風險，這進而可能對本公司業務造成重大且不利之影響。" 本公司亦曾經驗過，並預期將持續經驗重大媒體、立法及監管審查，以及訴訟、其他法律行動及監管調查，於美國及海外，關於用戶隱私權及資料保護、用戶之間互動及其他問題。例如，於過去幾年，本公司已收到並回應來自西班牙資料保護機構、斯洛維尼亞資料保護機構、希臘資料保護機構、奧地利資料保護機構及其他非歐盟資料保護機構，包括挪威資料保護機構及英國資訊委員會（"ICO"）以及各項美國監管機構之詢問。請參閱 "—本公司及與本公司合作之第三方皆受不同且快速變化的資料隱私權及資料保護監管架構所規範，本公司（或與本公司合作之第三方）實際或被認為未遵守這些新或變化的規範，過去已對本公司業務造成損害，且可能持續導致聲請、對本公司業務之變更
若發生任何損害、損失或財務處罰、營運成本增加，或用戶成長或參與度下降等情況，均可能對我們的業務造成重大影響。" 此外，其他調查也可能損害我們的聲譽與品牌，並可能在未來嚴重影響我們的聲譽與品牌。請參閱 "— 不利的媒體報導可能對我們的業務、品牌或聲譽造成重大且不利的影響。" 若發生損害我們聲譽或品牌的事件，將可能對我們的業務、財務狀況及營運成果造成重大且不利的影響。

我們維持、擴展、參與及實現用戶基礎價值，並增加收入的能力，取決於我們能否跟上用戶期望及產業技術變革的節奏，例如持續改進現有產品與服務。我們所處的產業特徵為技術快速變更、頻繁的新產品與服務宣佈與升級，以及變動的用戶需求，而我們的競爭對手，包括在線社交網路與交友應用產業中的企業，持續開發新的技術與產品與服務。因此，我們的表現將取決於我們能否適應此環境，例如持續提升產品與服務的速度、效能、功能、易用性與可靠性。若無法跟上快速的技術變革，將可能導致我們失去或無法增加市場佔有率，進而對我們的業務、財務狀況及營運成果造成重大且不利的影響。
